title: Crows Remember Your Face and Spread the Word
hook: Crows can tell human faces apart, and they seem to pass the word about bad ones
summary: Crows recognize individual human faces and are known to spread word of dangerous people with their calls.

text: A crow is staring right at you.
Those eyes might remember your face.
Crows can pick out individual human faces.
When they see a threatening face,
brain regions linked to attention and fear light up.

panels.text: I did nothing to a crow yesterday, right?

text: Crows are thought to pass word of dangerous people
to other crows through their calls.
A crow carrying off a cookie from the trash.
Crows are also known for using tools.
Ravens can even recognize themselves in a mirror.
There's a reason they have a reputation for brains.
it's safer to mind your manners.

panels.text: I'd better be good in front of crows
